verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples. The only related item is a Cloud Console playground (cerebras-docs-2), which is a separate feature from an API reference and earns no credit here. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec behind an interactive reference either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
